#### B. Usecase Layer ([`usecase.go`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/be-golang-app/task-003-20260826t051620z-df792ad7/internal/core/usecase/category/usecase.go), [`usecase_test.go`](file:///Users/sagaino/Documents/personal-ai-orchestrator/runs/workspaces/be-golang-app/task-003-20260826t051620z-df792ad7/internal/core/usecase/category/usecase_test.go))
- **Test cases**:
  - `TestUsecase_Create_Success`: Validasi pembuatan kategori baru dan mapping ID/audit fields.
  - `TestUsecase_Create_EmptyName`: Validasi rejection input kosong (`localerror.InvalidData`).
  - `TestUsecase_Create_RepoError`: Error handling repository.

  - `TestUsecase_List_RepoError`: Error propagation.
  - `TestUsecase_Delete_Success`, `TestUsecase_Delete_EmptyID`, `TestUsecase_Delete_NotFound`, `TestUsecase_Delete_RepoDeleteError`: Validasi alur penghapusan kategori.
